title: JapaneseAddress
description: A Japanese postal address as the value of an `address` Property: schema.org PostalAddress fields where the meaning matches, plus the Japanese structure (machiaza, chome, banchi, go), the JIS and local-government codes, the Address Base Registry town id and the residential-indication flag.

postalCode.description: Postal code, 7 digits with or without hyphen

addressLocality.description: Municipality name. For designated cities includes the ward (e.g. 横浜市中区)

machiaza.description: Town or district name (町字: 町名, 大字, 字), without chome

banchi.description: Banchi (番地) or, in residential-indication areas, the block number (街区符号)

go.description: Go (号) or, in residential-indication areas, the residence number (住居番号)

buildingName.description: Building name, room number and anything below go

residentialIndication.description: true in a residential-indication area (banchi/go are block and residence numbers), false for lot numbers (地番)

jisMunicipalityCode.description: Municipality code (JIS X 0402, 5 digits including the prefecture code)

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code (全国地方公共団体コード: JIS X 0402 plus a check digit, 6 digits)

abrMachiazaId.description: Address Base Registry town id (町字ID, 7 digits). Unique together with localGovernmentCode

addressText.description: Full address as one normalised line. Also the fallback when structured fields are unavailable
